assertions.assertion: Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was medically necessary
The patient presented with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient had a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The service was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The clinical indication note supports medical necessity for this diagnostic procedure
The denial decision does not preclude the possibility of future coverage if proper authorization is secured
